title: Summer Time Rendering: A Shadow on the Beach
alt: A white beach at noon under a deep blue sky with one great white cloud. On the sand at the right stands a black figure as tall as two men and very thin, with four long arms, a small head with a crest, and long fingers. Under it a pool of pure black spreads over the sand, and small black squares rise from it. A long tongue of the black runs toward a girl at the left, and its end is a flat hand. The girl stands with her back to us in a dark blue swimsuit. Her fair hair rises from her head and comes over in a great gold bow that ends in a point, like a blade, toward the black figure. Behind are the blue and green sea and a green island with a small red gate.
summary: A painting of Ushio against Shide on the beach from Summer Time Rendering in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Summer Time Rendering, the manga by Yasuki Tanaka. On the island of Hitogashima a shadow makes itself a copy of a person and then kills that person. The master of the shadows is Shide, who has four arms and wears black armour.

Ushio is a shadow too. She is the copy of a girl who drowned, and she fights on the side of the living. Her hair is her weapon. She can make it hard, like a blade. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
